regions.today: Today will be a bright, fresh day across Leinster with sunny spells. Showers will extend eastwards later this morning and will continue this afternoon and evening, some heavy with a chance of isolated thunderstorms. Highest temperatures 15 to 18 degrees with moderate to fresh southerly winds, decreasing mostly moderate later in the day.
regions.tonight: Tonight, showers will die out and it will become dry with clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 9 degrees with light to moderate southerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Thursday will be mainly dry with sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 15 or 16 degrees with moderate southerly winds.
